review_description: NSW Solar Hub provided excellent solar installation experience from start to finish. Professional  and highly experiencedteam completed the work efficiently. They maintained high level of cleanliness, ensuring everything was spotless after installation.  I highly recommend for anyone looking for quality solar installation at affordable price. Great job Mani and his team.
The quotation process, handling of calls, and installation were excellent. Everything was explained politely, including the different brands and available options.

Mani and his team gave the best quote I got from 5 installation company. They got the job completed within time frame, cleared all rubbish and were very polite when working at home. The bird cage advise was the best one. Thanks Mani and his team-awesome job.
Quoting was very reasonable, high quality work & materials.Installation went very well and went up to late light.Including 10 kwh Battery & 5 kwh Inverter

The quoting process was extremely transparent with multiple design suggestions to suit the needs of my home. The installer was happy to accommodate my request to prioritize my simple installation over another complex installation.
